headlines.title: ICE arrests far-right commentator Milo Yiannopoulos
headlines.description: The far-right commentator and self-described internet troll was arrested at the airport in New Orleans for staying in the country after his visa expired, according to DHS.

headlines.title: 'Dear Donald': Battleground district voters share their message to Trump
headlines.description: On his final day of the NBC News Drive to Decision Day series, NBC News senior national politics reporter Jon Allen joins Meet the Press NOW from Nebraska to recap his trip and hisvisit to the “blue dot” district.

headlines.title: 'I am not running for president,' Attorney General Todd Blanche says at Iowa State Fair
headlines.description: On day five of his Drive to Decision Day series, NBC News senior national politics reporter Jon Allen joins Meet the Press NOW to break down his one-on-one with Attorney General Todd Blanche at the Iowa State Fair in Des Moines.

headlines.title: ‘Fed up with a war they didn't want’: Midwestern voters air frustrations impacting the midterms
headlines.description: Senior National Politics Reporter Jonathan Allen joins Meet the Press NOW to discuss his conversations with frustrated voters on the ground in Iowa and Ohio ahead of the midterms in his Drive to Decision Day series.

headlines.title: ‘Resign. You’re destroying the country’: Republican voter in key Ohio district slams Trump
headlines.description: NBC News Senior National Politics Reporter Jon Allen cruises down I-80 in his Drive to Decision Day series to talk to voters in several battleground congressional districts that could determine the control of Congress. On day 3 of his road trip, Jon Allen visits Ohio’s 7th and 9th congressional districts.

headlines.title: Trump ‘doesn’t have a plan’ on Iran: Voters in key Pennsylvania district upset with handling of war
headlines.description: NBC News Senior National Politics Reporter Jon Allen hits the road for his Drive to Decision Day series to talk to voters in several battleground congressional districts that could determine the control of Congress. Jon Allen starts his road trip in New Jersey’s 7th congressional district and Pennsylvania’s 7th and 8th congressional districts.

headlines.title: White House teleprompter operator ordered to pay $172K for placing prediction market bets on Trump’s speeches
headlines.description: The Commodity Futures Trading Commission announced the penalties for Gabriel Perez, who made the bets through Kalshi.

headlines.title: Trump says he’ll visit Pentagon, rather than Ground Zero, for 9/11 ceremony
headlines.description: President Donald Trump will appear at the Pentagon to mark the 25th anniversary of the attacks on Sept.

headlines.title: Trump says U.S. has struck deal with Venezuela to take control of 65 billion barrels of oil reserves
headlines.description: President Donald Trump announced Friday that the U.S. had entered into an agreement with Venezuela to take control of the country’s 65 billion barrels of oil reserves.

headlines.title: Hegseth considering presidential run, sources tell NBC News
headlines.description: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth is considering a presidential run in 2028, sources told NBC News. Hegseth and his wife, Jennifer, have floated the idea of a presidential run for the past few months, believing he has some of the same attributes that have made Donald Trump popular with the MAGA movement, two people familiar with the situation said.

headlines.title: ICE plans to buy robot ‘dogs’ for some immigration enforcement operations
headlines.description: NBC News Senior Homeland Security Correspondent Julia Ainsley joins Meet the Press NOW to discuss ICE plans to spend up to $2 million on robot "dogs" for immigration enforcement operations.

headlines.title: Nebraska Democrat looks to oust GOP congressman as Iran war crosses 6 months
headlines.description: Chris Backemeyer, the Democrat looking to unseat Rep. Mike Flood (R-Neb.), joins Meet the Press NOW to discuss the Iran war's impact on the U.S. economy and the lack of options to end the conflict. NBC News' Yamiche Alcindor, Courtney Kube and Ben Kamisar discuss the economic, military and political implications of the war with Iran as the conflict reaches the six-month mark.
